why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the ChainOpera AI Terminal Go to the ChainOpera AI sign-in page , which is headed "Log in or sign up".
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet Choose one of the wallet options offered on the page and connect it. The page says that logging in and connecting a wallet is what earns points.
3 Step 3 : Read the policies you accept By continuing you agree to the Privacy Policy and read the Terms of Use .

4 Step 4 : Explore the agents in the Terminal The sign-in page lists no point-earning actions beyond connecting. The white paper overview describes what the Terminal offers, so you can see what there is to use.
